title: FeatureJet
description: The feedback board your AI agents work from: users vote, agents build over MCP. 22 tools.
summary: The feedback board your AI agents work from: users vote, agents build over MCP. 22 tools.
offersHint: The feedback board your AI agents work from: users vote, agents build over MCP. 22 tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.featurejet.com/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: FeatureJet API key as a Bearer token (a read-scope key enables read-only tools).

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: FeatureJet API key as a Bearer token (a read-scope key enables read-only tools).

toolsPreview.name: list_boards
toolsPreview.description: List boards available to the caller's FeatureJet API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_board
toolsPreview.description: Get one board by slug.

toolsPreview.name: create_board
toolsPreview.description:
Create a new feedback board, as a DRAFT.

        `slug` is the board's URL path segment (lowercase, hyphenated, unique);
        `name` is the display name. The new board's public URL 404s until a
        human publishes it from the dashboard -- `publish_board` is off by
        default (403 `publish_disabled`).

toolsPreview.name: publish_board
toolsPreview.description:
Publish a board so it is live at its public URL.

        OFF BY DEFAULT. Putting a board on the public internet is a human
        decision: unless the FeatureJet deployment has opted in, this returns
        403 `publish_disabled` and the owner publishes from the dashboard.
        Where it is enabled it needs a `write` (or `admin`) scoped key and an
        active subscription -- an org without one gets 403
        `subscription_required`.

toolsPreview.name: unpublish_board
toolsPreview.description:
Return a board to draft so its public URL stops serving it.

        Nothing is deleted; publish it again to bring it back.

toolsPreview.name: list_posts
toolsPreview.description: List posts for a board, optionally filtered by status, search, or tag.

toolsPreview.name: get_post
toolsPreview.description: Get one post by board slug and post id.

toolsPreview.name: create_post
toolsPreview.description: Create a post on a board.

toolsPreview.name: update_post
toolsPreview.description: Update mutable post fields; null queue_rank explicitly un-ranks.

toolsPreview.name: delete_post
toolsPreview.description: Delete a post by hiding it through the developer API.

toolsPreview.name: list_votes
toolsPreview.description: List vote metadata for a post.

toolsPreview.name: list_comments
toolsPreview.description: List comments for a post.

toolsPreview.name: create_comment
toolsPreview.description: Comment on a post as the board team, optionally replying to a comment.

toolsPreview.name: get_queue
toolsPreview.description:
Top UNCLAIMED posts in the owner's curated build order.

        Owner-ranked posts (queue_rank, lower = sooner) come first, then
        unranked planned posts by votes. Call this to find the next thing to
        build, then claim_post before starting work.

toolsPreview.name: claim_post
toolsPreview.description:
Atomically claim a post before working on it (double-work guard).

        ttl_seconds defaults to 3600 (max 86400); re-claiming with the same
        key extends the lease. Returns 409 if another key holds a live claim.

toolsPreview.name: release_post
toolsPreview.description: Release a post's claim so other agents can pick it up.

toolsPreview.name: add_evidence
toolsPreview.description:
Attach implementation evidence to a post (shown publicly).

        kind is one of branch|commit|pr|transcript|url; ref is the branch
        name, commit sha, or URL. Voters see these in the post page's
        "Implementation" section.

toolsPreview.name: propose_status
toolsPreview.description:
Propose a status change for the board owner to confirm.

        The agent-honest way to mark work done: nothing changes on the
        public board and no voter is notified until a human confirms the
        proposal from the dashboard. status is one of
        open|planned|in_progress|shipped|declined; a new proposal replaces
        any pending one. Prefer this over update_post's direct status flip.

toolsPreview.name: get_changelog
toolsPreview.description: List shipped posts for a board.

toolsPreview.name: get_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Get read-only analytics for a board.

toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Confirm the caller's API key by listing accessible boards.

toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Check MCP and FeatureJet API reachability for the caller's key.
